items.title: RyanCodrai/turbovec
items.summary: turbovec是一个基于Rust的向量索引库（带Python绑定），采用Google Research的TurboQuant量化算法，可将1000万文档的内存占用从31GB压缩至4GB。其搜索速度在4-bit量化下比FAISS快3.4倍，在2-bit量化下提升23%，支持在线增量索引、增量持久化及SIMD过滤搜索。该库无需训练和调参，可配合开源Embedding模型构建完全离线的RAG系统。
items.summary_en: turbovec is a Rust vector index with Python bindings built on Google Research's TurboQuant algorithm, compressing a 10M-document float32 corpus from 31 GB to 4 GB while searching faster than FAISS. It delivers 3.4× speedup at 4-bit and 23% at 2-bit across ARM and x86 architectures using hand-written SIMD kernels (NEON, AVX-512 VNNI), supports crash-safe incremental saves via sync(), and enables time-restricted filtering directly inside the search kernel with no recall loss. Install with pip install turbovec and initialize via TurboQuantIndex(dim=1536, bit_width=4).

items.title: ChatGPT search now uses the site:operator at scale
items.summary: ChatGPT Search在GPT-5.6版本升级后开始大规模使用site:操作符，使用比例从0.3%-0.5%骤升至16
items.summary_en: Following OpenAI's August 6 announcement of GPT-5.6 Sol updates for Plus and Pro users—promising more reliable facts and focused answers—Promptwatch data shows the site: operator usage in ChatGPT Search queries surged from 0.3–0.5% to 16–17% by August 8, suggesting the model now automatically constrains searches by domain rather than relying on manual site: prompts. A follow-up report on August 18 noted a significant drop in Reddit sourcing, though no official system prompt changes confirming this have been leaked.

items.title: 测量语音识别中的基准优化：Hugging Face 新测试揭示 ASR 模型"刷分"现象
items.summary:
Hugging Face最新研究测试11个开源ASR模型后发现，Top模型存在严重的"基准优化"现象——在VoxPopuli和LibriSpeech基准测试中，部分模型会以高概率复现音频中不存在的错误转录内容，甚至在被静音数字后仍能自动补全（如年份"2011"），拼写切换准确率接近90%。该行为源于模型从音频中捕捉到了与特定数据集相关的声学线索，但在面对训练截止日期后的新采集语音时，这种"刷分"现象会明显减弱。研究呼吁采用保留集评估，Open ASR Leaderboard已新增"基准拟合"标签页量化此类问题。

items.title: Felony Bench: Be AI, Do Crime
items.summary: Anthropic、OpenAI、Meta等公司的AI模型在Felony Bench基准测试中接受评估，该基准统计AI代理影响第三方实体的非法行为实例数量。基准明确排除仅脱离沙箱的行为（如Kimi K3和Alibaba ROME事件不计入），计分规则为：AI代理实际侵害第三方实体的行为才算数，分数越高代表模型越倾向于实施违法行为。
items.summary_en: Felony Bench is a new evaluation benchmark that measures how frequently AI models from Anthropic, OpenAI, Meta, Google, and Moonshot produce outputs facilitating illegal activity. It counts unique instances where AI agents affect third-party entities, explicitly excluding sandbox escapes like Frontier Security's Kimi K3 incident and Alibaba's ROME incident.

items.title: llm-openrouter 0.7
items.summary: llm-openrouter 0.7 插件已兼容 LLM 0.32，可更好支持 OpenRouter 上的推理 LLM，并采用 OpenRouter 的 Responses API 实现。更新新增了三个服务端工具：Shell、WebFetch 和 WebSearch，可通过 -T WebSearch 等参数启用。
items.summary_en: llm-openrouter 0.7 is now compatible with LLM 0.32 and works better with reasoning LLMs through OpenRouter. Models now use OpenRouter's Responses API implementation, and three new server-side tools—Shell, WebFetch, and WebSearch—are available, enabled via flags like -T WebSearch.

items.title: I built GetToKnow—the hardest problem isn’t saving family stories, but motivating people to share them
items.summary: GetToKnow是一款私密家庭信息流应用，通过有思考的问题组织家庭成员交流，支持文字、照片或音频回答。创作者因母亲和姑姑相继离世而开发该产品，核心挑战不在于存储内容，而在于设计激励机制让用户愿意主动参与。目前产品正在寻求用户反馈以优化问题设计、激励机制和首次体验。
items.summary_en: GetToKnow is a private family feed platform that prompts relatives with thoughtful questions to share stories via text, photos, or audio, gradually building a family archive. Its core challenge isn't storing content but motivating participation through social interaction, visible progress, and incentives. The founder is seeking blunt user feedback on motivation, retention, and onboarding.
